text:
sam-docs: Quick sync: discovered two problems while reviewing model-catalog PRs — (A) bench page references "per-variant seq_len=2048" but model-card for v2 says max_context=4096, confusing; (B) the compatibility matrix still links to old runtime flags doc (404).

lee-ml: Oof. For A, bench numbers were collected with different truncation rules (we used rolling-window=2048 for fair comparison vs older models). We should make that explicit on the benchmark table row not change the model-card limit.

jamie-eng: For B, I can update the compatibility link to the new flags doc and add an anchor. Which page is the source of truth for runtime flags now?

lee-ml: runtime/flags.md in the infra repo is canonical; permalink: https://internal.redwood/infra/runtime/flags#variant-compatibility. But public docs should link to the public-facing KB: /docs/runtime-flags#compatibility (we moved it last month).

sam-docs: Proposed action items:
1) Add a bench note column called "truncation / measurement" that states "benchmarks reported with rolling-window=2048 unless noted".
2) Keep model-card max_context as-is (4096) but add a short note: "benchmarks use 2048 rolling window for apples-to-apples comparison".
3) Fix compatibility matrix link to /docs/runtime-flags#compatibility and add a tooltip explaining Private deployments may have different defaults.
4) Add a unit test that ensures external links in model cards return 200.

jamie-eng: I can do 3 and 4. For the link test, do we want to fail CI on 404s? Might be noisy for internal-only URIs. Maybe only fail CI for public docs assets.

sam-docs: Good call. Make the test only run in the public-docs CI job. Add whitelist for internal hosts.

sdk-bot: Note: example snippet on embeddings page uses `model='nova-lite'` alias. If we add bench note about truncation we should also add a short compatibility line about alias vs explicit variant for Private (similar to previous thread).

lee-ml: Right. This thread ties into alias registry behavior. Add a 1-sentence callout in the model-catalog "compatibility" section: "Aliases map to variants in Hosted; Private deployments may require explicit variant names."

sam-docs: I'll open a docs PR with the bench column and model-card note. Jamie, want me to include your link-fix in the same PR or separate?

jamie-eng: Separate please, smaller scope. I'll send a tiny PR that updates the compatibility matrix link and adds the CI link-check for public docs. PR numbers to cross-reference in the changelog.

qa-bot: Reminder: please add an examples smoke test for any snippet that we change. The examples suite should run with minimal mocking:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(base_url="https://mock.redwood")
# ensure resolve_variant doesn't raise
c.resolve_variant("nova-lite")
```

sam-docs: Will add the smoke test and include a short example that uses explicit variant and alias patterns.

lee-ml: One more small thing: update the bench page tooltip to show the exact measurement command used (we have a short shell snippet). That helps reproducibility.

sam-docs: Added to the PR checklist. ETA 6 hrs. I'll tag @jamie-eng and @lee-ml in the PR for fast review.

jamie-eng: Thanks. I'll queue the CI job once PR is up.

sam-docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5502 — "model-catalog: clarify benchmark measurement, fix compatibility links, add snippet smoke test"

jamie-eng: LGTM pending CI. Left a nit about wording in the compatibility tooltip.

lee-ml: Approved from ML side.

qa-bot: CI passed for public-docs link checks :white_check_mark:. Example smoke tests ran with mocked resolve_variant :white_check_mark:.

sam-docs: Merged. I'll add a small changelog entry and create a KB note summarizing alias/variant expectations for Private customers.

lee-ml: Nice work team, this should reduce the "why does my model reject alias" tickets.

sam-docs: Agreed. Closing thread after changelog updates.
